description: IMF Management approved completion of the first review under Zimbabwe's SMP (SMP itself approved 2026-04-16). An SMP is a non-financing monitoring arrangement, not a lending program.

IMF Executive Board completed the 5th reviews of Kenya's EFF/ECF arrangements and approved an RSF arrangement as of Jul 2023. Program status after this date was NOT independently re-confirmed in this research pass and must be re-checked before being presented as current.

Malawi's prior ECF arrangement was terminated (per IMF FAQ). Reporting from May 2026 indicates Malawi and the IMF were set to begin talks toward a new ECF programme in June 2026; no confirmation found in this research pass that a new arrangement had been approved.
